{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only completed orders
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute stratified conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
stratified_clean = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute segment counts per channel
segment_counts = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute total count per channel
channel_totals = df_clean.groupby('channel').size()

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel
weighted_email = (stratified_clean[stratified_clean['channel'] == 'email'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted'] * 
                  segment_counts.loc['email'] / channel_totals['email']).sum()
weighted_paid_search = (stratified_clean[stratified_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search'].set_index('customer_segment')['converted'] * 
                        segment_counts.loc['paid_search'] / channel_totals['paid_search']).sum()

# Compute the difference
difference = weighted_email - weighted_paid_search

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Weighted average conversion rate (email): {weighted_email}")
print(f"Weighted average conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_paid_search}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
